description: This file defines an interface for CRON field operations, including methods to check satisfaction of a CRON expression, increment/decrement a DateTime object based on CRON field units, and validate CRON expressions.

classes.name: FieldInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling CRON field evaluations, modifications, and validation.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime satisfies a CRON expression.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object by the CRON field's unit, either forward or backward.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CRON expression string for correctness.
